name: detail-flow
title_zh: 电商详情页成套生成器：一张图起底，十张图收尾
tagline_zh: 给 AI 工具、SaaS、开发者产品做详情页，不用重画图。你给一张截图，它输出 10+ 张成套的 1:1 电商图。
tagline_en: For AI tools, SaaS, dev products: feed it a screenshot, get 10+ cohesive 1:1 product images with layout and copy.
desc_en: Build, redesign, polish, or review product detail pages for products, AI tools, models, SaaS features, developer products, plugins, ecommerce listings, and technical showcases. Use when the user provides a product image, reference image, screenshot, product concept, or existing page and asks for an independent 1:1 ecommerce image set, detail page, 10+-image product page, model page, product featur
why_zh: 它不套模板，而是按你的产品图逐张重绘，保持视觉一致。从概念到成页，独立完成，不依赖第三方设计服务。
why_en: No templates. It redraws each image from your source to keep visual consistency, and takes the job from concept to finished page.
limit_zh: 只处理产品详情页场景，不生成营销海报或社交图。需要你提供清晰的原始产品图或截图，模糊或低分辨率图会直接降低输出质量。
limit_en: Only for product detail pages, not social or poster art. Needs a clear source image; blurry or low-res input will visibly degrade output.
title_en: Ecommerce detail-page suite: 1 image in, 10+ page set out
